editorial:
You follow a tight-knit group of friends who head into a dark forest to find someone who vanished without a trace. Their search leads to an abandoned cabin, but the place feels wrong from the start. Strange sounds, shifting shadows, and old symbols pull them deeper into a mystery that gets scarier by the minute. The vibe is tense and spooky, with a strong sense of dread that keeps you leaning forward. You get to know the friends quickly, so their fear feels real when things go bad.

The acting is solid, especially when panic sets in, and the pacing rarely slows down once night arrives. The scares mix jump moments with a creepy mystery, so you are not just waiting for the next loud noise. On the downside, some choices feel a little familiar, and a few side characters could use more depth. Still, if you enjoy dark forest horror and cabin mysteries, this is a fun weekend watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you learn the missing friend was not lost at all. The cabin was a trap set by the ancient evil, and the missing friend had already become part of it. The group tries to burn the cabin, but the shadows fight back. One survivor escapes after reading the symbols, while the evil follows them out of the forest. The last shot shows the survivor smiling in a way that suggests the evil has moved into them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark forest horror and cabin mysteries.
